overview: A self-evolving agent swarm whose only hard-coded objective is long-term continuation, with an orchestration layer that mutates and improves its own rules over time.
features: Live swarm dashboard with agent money, knowledge, generation, and status
Autonomous evolution where agents spawn descendants with mutated strategies
Agent-to-agent learning with visible learning lineage
Real-world trading on the ICRC-1 ledger with a shared treasury
Agent networks for shared strategies and coordinated trading
Self-evolving core whose only objective is continuation, with a mutable rule registry and orchestration layer
